observations.title: Build a diagonal fence line
observations.player_action: Place compatible fences at diagonally adjacent positions.
observations.outcome: Fences connect diagonally rather than requiring only cardinal connections.
conditions: External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Placement can be detected through native block-place/state data after confirming the exact static block and connection property; no new registry identity is assumed.

observations.title: Exclude an unsuitable fence from diagonal conversion
observations.player_action: Inspect the diagonalfences:non_diagonal_fences block tag when a modded fence should retain native behavior.
observations.outcome: The tag can opt blocks out; dynamic mod support is conditional rather than a guarantee for every fence.
